lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately eight visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spacing between the first and second anterior columns is wider than the posterior columns, creating a localized sparse zone in the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs to form a grid-like structure. These intersections act as anchor nodes with increased local pixel intensity, most prominent in the central third of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition—high-intensity pixels on the dorsal aspect and deep-shadow low-intensity pixels on the ventral aspect—extending from the posterior gill margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A non-linear, whorl-like pattern of luminance bands is observed in the mid-flank region, where two vertical stripes curve to form a distinct 'U' shape between the standard grid nodes.
